g.aria-label: Fixed-Capacity Expert Buffers: S = ⌈γ · n k / E⌉ Slots per Expert (γ = 1.25)
Processed in parallel (E, S, d) bmm
What Happens to a Dropped Token?
Because the MoE layer sits inside a pre-norm residual branch Y = H + MoE(Norm(H)),
a dropped token receives 0 from the FFN and passes unchanged along the residual stream H!
